Greetings, I am one of the guiding spirits. My brothers and I are here to guide you and explain this game to you. Do you need our services?
Your current target is highlighted with a symbol and is displayed in the bottom left of the window. When you turn or move, the current target changes automatically.
The colour of the symbol changes depending on whether your target is a friend or foe. Allies and neutral characters are displayed in green or blue, enemies in red.
By clicking the left mouse button, you can attack the current target with your primary weapon. Currently, that would be a spiked club.
In the bottom right, you can see an overview map. Black areas are territory that has not yet been explored.
The red bar over the portrait in the top left indicates your current health, while the blue bar shows how much mana you possess. Should the red bar sink to zero, your game character will perish.
Now it is time for your first fight. Follow the path, You may find a few of my brothers along the way, talk to them for more helpful hints.
Excellent. Would you like more enemies than in the tutorial?
Ah, you seek a real challenge. Good luck.
The giant spider you defeated has an item. Focus on the carcass and click the left mouse button to see what loot you can retrieve. Then click on the sabre to take it with you.
How can I change weapons?
Can I fight with two one-handed weapons at the same time?

By using the mouse wheel, you can switch through all the weapons in your inventory. Or you can open your inventory, by pressing I, where you are able to change your weapons or armour. You cannot open your inventory while we are talking.
Yes. To do so, open your inventory and place a weapon in each hand. The weapon in the second hand is used in battle by clicking the right mouse button
Between the beastmen's barracks, you will find a chest. Open it and take the bow.
How can I use the bow?
When using the bow, can I aim manually?
With the left mouse button, you can fire an arrow at your current target, unless it is a friendly unit. Of course, the bow does not have unlimited range.
By holding down the CTRL key, you can lock the current target. This can be useful when facing multiple, moving units.
Yes. If you hold down the left mouse button, crosshairs will appear and you can take aim. As soon as you release the button, the arrow is loosed.
Trolls are strong in close combat, but they are sluggish. Perhaps you should try to take them out with the bow before they reach you.
One of the trolls was carrying a ring. I suggest you take it.
Of what use is this ring?
This particular ring enhances your strength and endurance. More strength increases the damage you cause in battle, endurance your life energy.
Talk to Randolf, the cleric. He will accompany and protect you.
Randolf will follow you. He is a powerful healer and a faithful companion. However, his close combat skills are limited, so you will have to protect him if it comes to battle.
You are facing a succubus, an extremely dangerous magical creature. This would be a good time to use those daggers.
Beyond this hill, two tree creatures are locked in battle. Help the treant by assisting to take down the bloodash. This is an ideal opportunity to practice backstabbing with the daggers.
Talk to the warrior named Jon, he and his companion would make good allies.
The attack has been thwarted. It is time to go north and search for Eowyn and the lost elves.
The cyclops is as nasty an adversary as he is strong. It is worth approaching this fight tactically. Jon has excellent armour and would be well-suited to draw the enemy's attention.
How can I give allied units the order to attack?
Send him into close combat alone, while you and the others attack from a distance. Your companions can carry out various orders during battle.
The simplest order you can give your units is to attack a particular enemy. First you need to target the enemy to send a command.
By pressing 0, all friendly units will attack the targeted enemy. Release the right mouse button when you are done with your orders.
The cyclops was carrying a magic staff. Take it with you.
What kind of magic staff is this?
And how do I use the staff?
Does the magic staff also have a special attack?

Just like the bow, the staff is a two-handed weapon. Using the left mouse button, you can cast the spell on the current target, and with the right button, you can use the staff as a melee weapon - it is, however, not as effective as other weapons.
Also note that you cannot cast spells endlessly. Each spell cast consumes some of your mana reserves, which must then regenerate. Some enemies are partly or even entirely immune to magic.
Yes. Similar to the bow, you can hold down the left mouse button to aim the spell, and cast it by releasing the button. When used in this manner, the spell has a much stronger effect.
Try using the cyclops magic staff against the skeletons. When your mana is depleted, your best choice is either the club and sabre. Arrows and daggers are rather ineffective against skeletons.
The creatures in front of you are known as blades, who although undead are deadly fighting machines. This is a chance to show what you have learned so far.
The blade leader was carrying a  large sword with him. Take it.
How can I use the two-handed sword?
Aside from the normal attack with the left mouse button, you can also hold down the button to deal  a crippling blow. Be careful, however, this move leaves you vulnerable while preparing it.
You found the lost elves! Talk to Eowyn, their leader, to discuss the situation. Maybe you should join forces with them.
What is this robe for?
How can I command the elves?
They will follow you and give support in battle. Just like your companions, you can give the elves orders. The group of elven warders is assigned to the key 4, the archers to 5.
The icons in the middle of the upper menu symbolise the available groups. The numbers underneath the icons indicate how many units are contained in the respective group.
You are entering the territory of the dark elves. They are masters of both black and mental magic, so you should expect a few unpleasant surprises.
What power does this magic staff have?
Using this powerful staff, you can freeze enemies for a short time. The special attack of this staff is a powerful blizzard. But be careful, it will harm your allies as well.
This dark elf camp is the last obstacle on the way to the Draug. Good luck.
Am I glad to see you! Those trolls were hot on my tail!
I belong to the group of Jon Greywind, we were summoned here by Eowyn and her tribe of elves. A Draug has crawled up from the depths under the North Mountains!
If you want to help the elves, then I will join you. Shall we set out together?
Well, what have you decided?
Yes, we will help the elves. Let's go!
Fine. It's your decision. I will be resting here for a while. Come back if you should change your mind.
You're just in time! We can use any sword arm we can get!
Well, what will it be then?
Let us join forces and protect the village!
My people and I came to protect the elves from the Draug, but these fools wouldn't wait for us. And of course Randolf getting lost as usual was no big help.
The coming of the Draug has attracted all manner of evil creatures, trolls and bloodashs are leaving the Dark Forest in hordes and ravaging the land. Soon, they will reach this village!
Let us defend the settlement together! Help us, and we will help you! What do you say?
Ah, that's the spirit! Well, there's no time to waste, those bloodashs from the Dark Forest are almost upon us. Get ready!
Are you ready to defeat the Draug?
Follow me, we will destroy the Draug!
We set out to defeat the Draug that threatens our land
Will you finish what you have started? Will you accompany us in our quest against the Draug and his myrmidons?
So be it, our lives for yours. Take this robe as a sign of our respect. Prepare for battle, sisters, today we must prove our courage!
You are like the lion, powerful but without wisdom. Go then, go alone, and may the gods have mercy on you.

Their death-bringing Blades have already reached the edge of the glacier!
They have driven the ancient cyclops from his cave, and now he also ravages the land!

I don't know if I will make it there alone, but if you come with me, I will certainly try. Let me know if you are willing to accompany me to the elven village.
Does the dagger have a special attack?
Daggers cause slightly less damage, but are particularly quick weapons, well suited to hindering enemy units with magic skills from casting spells.
When you are holding the dagger in your right hand, you can perform a so-called backstab attack. This is only possible when standing behind an enemy, but inflicts massive damage.
As soon as you release the left mouse button, the special attack will be performed. You will have the opportunity to give this a try later on, almost any weapon has a special attack.
